column3: “Respect and fear” replaces fear and trembling; the obedience to Christ is expanded.
Eye-service is explained as pleasing them while watched; “heart” replaces soul.
The good received back becomes a reward for doing good.
Blood and flesh reverse the order; “world’s” matches the Textus Receptus “of this age” (αἰῶνος).
Every kind of prayer explains all prayer.
“Pray” supplies a verb; the chain is plural.
